name: stale_aggregate
description: In main.go, the POST /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems handler inserts a new lineitem for an existing order but never recalculates or updates orders.o_totalprice. The GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey handler later reads o_totalprice directly from orders, so after this write endpoint modifies detail rows, the parent aggregate can be stale and incorrect.
